resources.string: Controls whether notifications show sender names and message content. When off, both are hidden. This applies to every account on this device, and you can change it back at any time.
Tries again to save your notification preview choice. Until it saves, the change may be lost after you restart the app.
Opens the notification sound and vibration options. You can preview the White Noise tones here and open Android\'s settings for each category of alert.
Opens the Android notification permission and battery policy for White Noise. These settings affect whether alerts can reach you while the app is in the background.
Opens Android\'s own notification settings for White Noise. There you can change sounds, importance and which categories can alert you on this device.
Shows whether Android lets White Noise send notifications. Tapping it opens the Android settings where you can change this permission.
Shows how Android\'s battery policy treats White Noise. Tapping it opens the Android battery settings, where you can change how freely the app may run in the background.
Android is blocking notifications for White Noise. Tapping this opens Android Settings, where you can turn them on again.
Asks Android to let White Noise send notifications. If you decline, you can change your answer later in Android settings.
Opens Android\'s settings for this category of alerts, where you choose its sound, vibration and importance. The value shown is the sound Android currently uses for it.
Plays this White Noise tone so you can hear it, and a second tap stops it. Previewing does not change any alert sound.
Adds the White Noise tones to Android\'s sound picker so you can choose them for notification categories, conversations or people. Adding them does not change any alert by itself.
Retries the saved notification setup work that did not finish. The message below it says which step is waiting.
Blocks screenshots and hides White Noise from the preview in Android\'s recent apps list. Turn it off if you want to allow screenshots. This is a device setting.
Asks your keyboard not to learn from what you type in White Noise. Some keyboards ignore the request, so it cannot be guaranteed. This is a device setting.
Asks for your device screen lock when you return to White Noise. It needs a screen lock set up in Android first. This is a device setting.
Opens Android security settings so you can set up a screen lock. Device authentication needs one before you can turn it on.
Chooses how long White Noise can stay in the background before it asks for your screen lock again. The options run from immediately to 15 minutes.
Opens the list of people you have blocked. The number shows how many there are, and you can unblock someone from that list.
Sets the disappearing-message timer for new chats and groups this profile starts. You can still change it in each conversation.
Opens the options for sharing usage data and diagnostic logs, and for managing the logs stored on this device. The value shows the current setting.
Opens the network choices for automatically downloading this type of media. Every matching network rule must allow a download, and manual downloads always work.
Restores the default automatic download rules for every media type. It is available only after you have changed them.
Asks you to confirm, then clears the queued automatic downloads for this profile. Downloads already running and manual downloads continue.
Turns automatic downloads back on so they follow your network rules again.
Chooses the size of photos and voice messages you send from now on. Videos and audio files are never re-encoded, and messages you already sent do not change.

Shows previews of public JPEG image links inside chats. It is off by default because a Blossom link may reveal your IP address to its host. Turning it off clears the previews already loaded, and links still open.
Opens a view of what White Noise stores on this device, with tools to free up space.
Tries to load your storage information again.

Opens a list of the largest attachments on this device, biggest first. You can select some and remove them. Messages stay, and you can download attachments again while the sender\'s copy is still available.

Asks you to confirm, then removes attachments received before a date you choose, in every chat, from this device. Messages stay, and you can download attachments again while the sender\'s copy is still available.

Asks you to confirm, then removes attachments in this chat received before a date you choose from this device. Messages stay, and you can download attachments again while the sender\'s copy is still available.
Asks you to confirm, then deletes pictures and temporary files kept on this device. The amount shown is what it frees. Profile and group pictures download again when you need them.
Chooses how long attachments stay on this device. Older ones are removed now and as they age, and downloading one again keeps it for the full period. Messages stay.
Opens the attachments stored for this chat.
Asks you to confirm, then removes every attachment in this chat from this device. Messages stay, and you can download attachments again while the sender\'s copy is still available.
Selects or deselects this attachment so you can remove it together with others. Nothing is removed until you choose Remove.
Selects every attachment in this list so you can remove them together. Nothing is removed until you choose Remove.
Selects only the attachments loaded so far. More load as you scroll, and nothing is removed until you choose Remove.
Clears the current selection without removing anything.
Removes the selected attachments from this device, after you confirm. Messages stay, and you can download attachments again while the sender\'s copy is still available.
Opens a menu with the diagnostics health view, a send-to-self test and an option to clear the diagnostic entries listed on this screen.
Reloads the diagnostic counters and status values shown in this sheet.
Runs a delivery test. It creates a temporary group, sends a test message to it and archives it, so you can check that sending works from this device.

Collects privacy-safe timing events on this device. It stops after 30 minutes or when the app restarts, and you can turn it off sooner. While on, the events are included in the next Stored Diagnostic Logs export.
Copies the privacy-safe timing events from the current or last session so you can paste them elsewhere.
Opens a list of the Marmot audit files stored on this device so you can pick specific ones to save or share.
Saves or shares this device\'s diagnostic logs as one archive. You are asked to confirm before the export starts.
Removes the diagnostic logs stored on this device after you confirm. Copies already uploaded and your sharing setting stay as they are.
Shows whether diagnostic log delivery is active, retrying, paused, off or not set up, with the HTTP status code when there is one.
Shows when audit log delivery last succeeded. It reads Never if none has succeeded yet.
Shows how much audit log data is stored on this device and waiting to upload.
Tries to resume sending audit logs now. It appears only while delivery is paused.
Checks the current audit log delivery status again.
Chooses how long audit logs stay on this device. Choosing a shorter period asks you to confirm, then deletes older logs on this device, including ones still waiting to upload.
Unblocks this person. Tapping the row starts the unblock for this person only.
Silences ordinary message alerts in this conversation. Direct mentions can still notify you. Turn it off to get ordinary alerts again.
Opens the vibration pattern choices for new messages in this conversation. You can preview each pattern once before choosing.
Turns this category of alerts on or off for this conversation on this device. The line below it tells you when Android blocks the category or the chat is muted.
Opens Android\'s sound and notification settings for this category in this conversation. The line below shows whether this chat has its own setting or uses the global default.
Uses the chat and global notification settings for this person instead of a custom rule.
Mutes message notifications from this person. It applies only to messages; delivery and unread counts do not change.
Opens Android\'s settings for notifications from this person, where you can set a custom sound and behavior. Custom settings apply across conversations for this account.
Chooses the vibration pattern for notifications from this person.
